newsitem.title: USA: Pulitzer sees Q3 strength spillover to Q4.
newsitem.headline: Pulitzer sees Q3 strength spillover to Q4.

text.p: Pulitzer Publishing Co, reporting higher-than-expected third-quarter earnings, said results benefitted from a 6.5 percent decline in newsprint expense and from stronger broadcasting advertising revenues, factors that should also help fourth-quarter performance.
"We should continue to see the effects of increased political spending and lower newsprint costs in our fourth quarter," said chairman Michael Pulitzer in a statement.
Earlier Thursday, the multimedia company reported quarterly earnings of $0.79 per share, up from $0.59 a year ago and ahead of the First Call consensus of $0.70.
Pulitzer said its third quarter combined strong performances by its publishing and broadcasting businesses, including strong cash flow from the Scripps League Newspapers Inc it acquired on July 1.
"Our acquisitions performed well during the quarter, adding $4.5 million in operating cash flow and, excluding non-recurring costs, diluting earnings by only one cent," Pulitzer said.
